name: ruact-flight-client-compat-spike
description: Story 18-0: does the official React Flight client decode ruact's payloads? See ../../decisions/flight-client-compatibility.md

scripts.consume: for d in react ruact ruact-fixed extra validated; do echo "== $d"; NODE_ENV=production node consume.mjs payloads/$d; done
scripts.consume:dev: for d in ruact-fixed extra validated; do echo "== $d"; NODE_ENV=development node consume.mjs payloads/$d; done
scripts.stream: NODE_ENV=production node stream.mjs && NODE_ENV=development node stream.mjs
scripts.browser: cd vite-app && vite build && vite preview --port 4173
